description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `JsonCommand` which provides a wrapper around JSON payloads representing commands. It offers various helper methods to extract, compare, and check parameters within the JSON, supporting validation and change detection logic for different data types. The class is used to facilitate command parameter handling in an API context within the Fineract project.

classes.name: JsonCommand
classes.description: An immutable class encapsulating a JSON command payload, providing helper methods for parameter extraction, change detection, and validation within the API handling context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JsonCommand instance from raw JSON string and parsed JSON.

methods.name: fromExistingCommand
methods.description: Factory method to creates a new JsonCommand based on an existing one, with optional modifications.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the raw JSON string of the command.

methods.name: parsedJson
methods.description: Returns the parsed JSON element representing the command.

methods.name: jsonElement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific JSON element by parameter name.

methods.name: jsonFragment
methods.description: Returns the JSON fragment (serialized form) of a parameter.

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the JSON payload.

methods.name: hasParameter
methods.description: Alias for parameterExists.

methods.name: hasParameterValue
methods.description: Checks if a parameter has a value (i.e., is not null or empty).

methods.name: dateFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format string specified in the JSON, if any.

methods.name: locale
methods.description: Returns the locale string specified in the JSON, if any.

methods.name: isChangeInLongParameterNamed

methods.name: isChangeInDateParameterNamed

methods.name: isChangeInTimeParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalTime parameter has changed, given a specific time format.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalTimeParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalTime parameter has changed.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalDateTimeParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDateTime parameter has changed.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalDateParameterNamed

methods.name: localDateValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Gets the LocalDate value of a parameter.

methods.name: localTimeValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Gets the LocalTime value of a parameter.

methods.name: extractMonthDayNamed
methods.description: Extracts a MonthDay value from a parameter.

methods.name: dateValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Gets the LocalDate value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInStringParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a String parameter value has changed.

methods.name: enumValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Converts a parameter string value to an Enum value.

methods.name: stringValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves the String value of a parameter.

methods.name: stringValueOfParameterNamedAllowingNull

methods.name: mapValueOfParameterNamed

methods.name: isChangeInBigDecimalParameterNamed

methods.name: bigDecimalValueOfParameterNamed

methods.name: bigDecimalValueOfParameterNamedDefaultToNullIfZero

methods.name: isChangeInIntegerParameterNamedDefaultingZeroToNull

methods.name: isChangeInIntegerParameterNamed

methods.name: integerValueOfParameterNamed

methods.name: integerValueSansLocaleOfParameterNamed

methods.name: isChangeInArrayParameterNamed
